- [USER] User inquired about the best time of year to visit Seoul.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Spring (March to May) is mild with cherry blossoms and festivals like the Seoul Lantern Festival and Yeon Deung Hoe Lotus Lantern Festival.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Summer (June to August) is warm and humid, suitable for hiking, outdoor activities, and music festivals like Ultra Korea.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Autumn (September to November) is considered the best time due to beautiful fall colors and events like the Seoul International Fireworks Festival.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Winter (December to February) can be freezing but offers a magical winter wonderland experience with ice-skating and Christmas festivities.
